Settings

The Next job line at the top of the screen: what to do next and where.
Helper arrows: the way to the next job.
First-time cards: the game pauses to explain something the first time it happens.
Train messages: a short note when a train is due, comes in, is ready or leaves. Refusals always show.
Lessons: the six short lessons (switches, tickets, unloading, loading, delivery, pickup) come again, each at its moment.
Dev mode: a test panel for line building (the rail crew, hired workers, the line).
Start over: delete this saved game and begin a new one.
